Project Summary

Project Name: SPACE RELICS – The Machines That Never Came Home

NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026

SPACE RELICS is an interactive educational digital museum that brings NASA's abandoned equipment on the Moon and Mars back to life through storytelling.

NASA has left behind several rovers, landers, and scientific instruments after completing their missions. Although these machines are no longer operational, they have contributed significantly to space exploration and scientific discoveries.

Our project aims to help students understand the history, purpose, achievements, and scientific contributions of these machines through an engaging virtual experience.

Users can explore interactive Moon and Mars maps, discover famous NASA missions such as Apollo 11, Sojourner, Opportunity, and InSight, view mission timelines, read engaging stories, and participate in educational quizzes.

Our goal is to transform forgotten space equipment into inspiring educational experiences, making space science accessible, interactive, and exciting for the next generation of explorers.
